subject: Engineering Fundamentals
title: The Golden Gate: An American Icon
description: One-minute skill: The Golden Gate: An American Icon.

hook.text: When the Golden Gate Bridge was proposed in 1916, critics said it was impossible. The bay was too wide and too windy.

buildup.text: Joseph Strauss designed a hybrid cantilever-suspension bridge. Then Irving Morrow chose International Orange paint.

discovery.text: The bridge's main cables contain 80,000 miles of wire — enough to circle the Earth three times.

twist.text: A safety net below the deck saved 19 workers' lives during construction. They called themselves the Half-Way-to-Hell Club.

climax.text: The bridge opened in 1937 and is still painted constantly. When painters reach one end, they start over.

punchline.text: They never stop painting the Golden Gate Bridge.

quiz.question: What was unusual about the safety net used during Golden Gate Bridge construction?
options: It was the first time a safety net was used on a bridge project and saved 19 lives
It was made of recycled fishing nets from the bay
It was only installed after 10 workers had already fallen
